title: The Fifth Page Manifests
next_chapter_hook: When the authority of The Writer was seared into Chen Ji's divine soul, the Tianji Record itself emitted a sigh spanning ten thousand years—a true secret that Mo Xiansheng had never revealed.

text.content: Blood seeped from his fingertips, flowing along the blood-colored text patterns on the seven hundredth page. Chen Ji felt a cold suction force devouring his essence blood, like an invisible beast had clamped onto his throat, being drained drop by drop. The pain spread from his fingertips to his meridians, his vision blurring, yet in the chaos he glimpsed a ray of light—the Fifth Page was tearing itself from the void.

A muffled rumbling echoed from the depths of the ruins, countless golden cracks splitting across the ground. These patterns resonated with Chen Ji's bloodline, a searing force surging from his dantian, washing through his meridians. He felt his blood boiling, every cell screaming—this was no ordinary awakening, but some deeper contract being forcibly established.

dialogue.content: "The Fifth Page... It has finally manifested." Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul voice trembled as it rang out, "Chen Xuan exhausted his entire life's effort back then and still couldn't summon this complete page—and you, with seven hundred pages of fragments and your own bloodline, have activated it!"

text.content: The void tore apart, the Fifth Page slowly emerging like silk wrapped in flames. The characters on the page were no longer the vague prophetic visions from before, but chillingly clear, perfectly complete prophecies. Chen Ji stared at those words, each character branding itself into his eyes like a searing iron.

"Ten thousand years ago, Heaven's Way used all things as kindling, all living beings as flames, burning this sacrifice to forge an eternal, indestructible order. The offering is set, the bloodline chosen, only lacking one death to complete its work. Now there is a descendant of the Chen clan bearing the Tianji Record, who has glimpsed Heavenly Secrets—you should know: your death is the final piece of the sacrifice. Die, and the unfinished game from ten thousand years ago will be complete."

Chen Ji's hand trembled. Not from fear, but from rage. The chess game set up ten thousand years ago, the offering selected ten thousand years ago, the ending written ten thousand years ago—since birth, was he, Chen Ji, merely a lamb waiting to be slaughtered? Did Heaven's Eye regard him as a chess piece, the Tianji Record as a vessel, and now did the Fifth Page want him to die willingly?

dialogue.content: "Hmph." Chen Ji suddenly laughed, that laughter echoing through the empty ruins, carrying a hint of madness, "What a magnificent game from ten thousand years ago! What a predetermined ending! Heaven's Eye, what do you take me, Chen Ji, to be? Meat on your chopping block, or fuel in your furnace?"

text.content: Just as Chen Ji laughed in his fury, the text on the Fifth Page suddenly changed. Below the prophecy, a line of tiny golden characters slowly appeared, like a secret hidden in the abyss finally revealing a corner: "However, beyond Heaven's Way, there are variables. The Writer may wield the pen to rewrite fate, but must use oneself as the guide, and soul as the ink."

Chen Ji froze for an instant, then understood the meaning of these small characters. The Writer—the Tianji Record had not only given him the ability to foresee the future, but also the possibility to rewrite fate. However, this authority came with a price: using oneself as the guide, and soul as the ink—this meant he would be forever bound to the Tianji Record, becoming its spokesperson, becoming another chess piece of Heaven's Way.

dialogue.content: "Do you see it now?" Mo Xiansheng's voice was low, "This was the choice Chen Xuan faced back then. He refused the authority of The Writer and chose another path—so he died, the Tianji Record shattered, and the ten-thousand-year layout restarted. And you, Chen Ji, will you repeat his mistake?"

choice.prompt: The complete prophecy of the Fifth Page has manifested. Chen Ji faces a life-and-death choice: accept death to complete the sacrifice from ten thousand years ago, or become The Writer and rewrite the rules.

choices.description: Since the ending was predetermined ten thousand years ago, why struggle in vain? Perhaps death is true liberation.
choices.visible_cost: Lose everything, personally end all schemes
choices.risk_hint: Through countless kalpas, forever part of the chess game

text.content: Chen Ji's hand slowly reached toward the Fifth Page. The moment his fingertip touched the prophecy, a blinding white light enveloped him entirely. He felt his consciousness being drawn away, the passage of his life clearly visible—is this what sacrifice feels like? So simple, so brutal.

choices.description: Rewriting rules requires power, and power requires sacrifice. Better to become the chess player than the piece.

choices.visible_reward: Wield the pen to rewrite fate, become an existence beyond Heaven's Way

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly pulled his finger back, cold fire blazing in his eyes. "The Writer? Interesting." He sneered, "Since Heaven wants me dead, I shall wield the pen and rewrite this Heaven's rules!" Before the words even faded, the golden characters on the Fifth Page suddenly burst forth with dazzling light, a torrent of information flooding into his divine soul—that was The Writer's authority and its price.

choices.visible_cost: Missing the Possible Chance of Liberation

text.content: Chen Ji did not rush to make a choice, but quietly gazed at the prophecy on the fifth page. A layout ten thousand years ago, a sacrifice ten thousand years later—this was all too perfect, too perfect to seem like the handiwork of Heavenly Dao, but rather as if someone had deliberately crafted it. He suddenly recalled something Mo Xiansheng once said: "The Tianji Record is merely one of the many chess pieces Heavenly Dao has placed in the mortal world." Then who was the one who set these chess pieces?

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji..." Mo Xiansheng's voice suddenly grew serious, "Whatever choice you make, think carefully—the Eye of Heavenly Dao never makes a losing trade. Showing you these two options is itself a trap."

text.content: This sentence was like a basin of cold water poured over Chen Ji's head. He suddenly realized a problem: if Heavenly Dao truly wanted him dead, why would it let him see the fifth page? Why would it let him know about the existence of the Writing Authority? Was all of this part of an even greater game?

choice.prompt: Mo Xiansheng's warning made Chen Ji realize the complexity of the choice. After understanding this might be another trap, he had to make a decision.

choices.description: Since there are traps within traps, he would turn the tables—become the Writing Brush holder, but keep his trump cards.
choices.visible_cost: Bound to the Tianji Record, Yet Retaining Partial Freedom
choices.visible_reward: Obtaining the Writing Authority While Preserving the Chance for a Comeback

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath and made his decision. "I accept the authority of the Writing Brush." His voice was calm and resolute, "But I have a condition—I want to retain part of my self-awareness, not to be completely devoured by the Tianji Record." The moment he finished speaking, the text on the fifth page suddenly began to violently tremble, golden light mixed with a thread of blood—that was the Tianji Record testing his sincerity.

choices.description: Since both options were traps, he would break the chessboard—Chen Ji would not be a chess piece.
choices.visible_cost: Thoroughly Offending the Eye of Heavenly Dao
choices.visible_reward: Forging a Third Path, Taking Control of One's Own Fate

text.content: "I choose neither option." Chen Ji suddenly smiled, that smile carrying a determination to break all bridges. "Since this is a trap, I will be the one who breaks the game." He urgently mobilized the Heavenly Fate Value remaining in his body, pouring it all toward the fifth page—not to accept, but to counterattack. Golden and blood-colored light intertwined and collided in the air, and a desolate wail echoed from the depths of the ruins.

Just as the two choices were being settled, the text on the fifth page suddenly changed. The originally complete prophecy began to shatter, countless tiny cracks spreading from the edges of the prophecy, as if some force was tearing this ten-thousand-year-old layout apart from within. At the same time, a blurry figure appeared faintly in the depths of the page—a woman's silhouette, delicate and fragile, yet it made Chen Ji's heart tighten.

Chen Nian! His sister, the girl taken by the Holy Sect as the "Heavenly Fate Lock Key," why would she appear in the prophecy on the fifth page? Chen Ji's heart pounded violently, an ominous premonition rising. Could Chen Nian's existence be more than just interference with foresight? Did she have connections to this ten-thousand-year-old sacrifice that he was unaware of?

dialogue.content: "Do you see it?" Mo Xiansheng's voice suddenly became extremely grave, "This is the secret I never told you. The Heavenly Fate Lock Key can not only interfere with foresight—she herself is another key to the sacrifice. Chen Xuan had deduced countless times with the Tianji Record, and every successful fate alteration required two sacrifices—one Writing Brush holder, one Lock Key."

text.content: Chen Ji felt a wave of dizziness. In the layout from ten thousand years ago, his sister was not a randomly selected experimental subject by the Holy Sect, but a chess piece already calculated into the scheme. From the moment Chen Nian was born, she was destined to be drawn into this chess game. And everything he, as her brother, had planned, in the eyes of Heavenly Dao, was merely helping them raise Chen Nian to become a more suitable sacrifice.

choice.prompt: After learning that Chen Nian was also part of the sacrifice, Chen Ji had to make a final decision—for his sister's sake, how would he choose?

text.content: Chen Ji raised his head sharply, his eyes blazing with resolve. "Master Mo, tell me, how do I save her?" His voice was low but resolute. "Even if I must oppose the Heavenly Dao, even if I must burn through all my Heavenly Fate, I will keep her alive." Before the words finished echoing, the characters on the fifth page suddenly trembled violently—the Heavenly Dao's Eye was responding to his determination.

text.content: Chen Ji closed his eyes, his fists clenched so tight his knuckles cracked. Reason told him Chen Nian's key identity might be the breakthrough point; but as her brother, he couldn't accept using his sister's safety as a bargaining chip. This tearing sensation made him nearly suffocate. "If I can't even protect her, what use is this breakthrough to me?" he murmured to himself, his voice carrying a hint of self-mockery.

Just as Chen Ji wrestled internally, the blurry figure on the fifth page suddenly grew distinct for an instant. It was a face bearing a seventy percent resemblance to his own, with youthful features around the eyes and brows, but tinged with gloom from years of imprisonment. Chen Nian's lips slightly parted, as if speaking. Chen Ji couldn't hear any sound, yet he grasped the lip movement—Brother, save me.

In that moment, every scheme and consideration in Chen Ji's mind dissipated like smoke. He remembered the days spent together in the dilapidated ancestral hall during childhood, his sister's heartbreaking screams when she was taken away, and how the sole beacon in his heart throughout these years of feigning weakness was the goal of finding her. "Very well." Chen Ji spoke softly, his voice eerily calm. "Since the Heavenly Dao demands two sacrifices, I shall ensure it receives neither."

Chen Ji drew a deep breath, activating the remaining Heavenly Fate within him, pouring all his spiritual consciousness into the fifth page. Not acceptance, not rejection, but—rewriting. He would wield the authority of the one who holds the brush to completely rewrite this sacrifice from ten thousand years ago. The characters on the fifth page trembled violently, golden and crimson light intertwining into an impenetrable net that enveloped Chen Ji entirely. He sensed his consciousness being torn apart and reorganized, with countless streams of information flooding into his spirit—the complete truth of that sacrifice ten thousand years ago.

When the authority of the one who holds the brush was seared into Chen Ji's spirit, a sigh echoing across ten thousand years emanated from the Tianji Record's core—Master Mo's most concealed truth. "Chen Ji," Master Mo's voice resonated, "from this moment forward, you become the new author. Yet remember, wielding this authority carries its own price—each rewriting draws you closer to the Tianji Record itself, until ultimately, you become the Record." Chen Ji, feeling that unprecedented power coursing through him, curled his lips into a cold, mocking smile. The Heavenly Dao's Eye had spent ten thousand years orchestrating this, selecting him as a piece? Then he would become the master of the chessboard, turning the entire game topsy-turvy!
